import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { KDISemanticDatabaseMaintainer, MAINTAINER_VERSION, MAINTAINER_INSTRUCTION_VERSION } from "../db/semantic-database-maintainer";
const root=path.resolve(import.meta.dirname,"../.."), source=path.join(root,"reports/semantic-search/database-enrollment"), out=path.join(root,"reports/semantic-search/database-maintainer");mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});
const audit=JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(source,"database_semantic_readiness_audit.json"),"utf8")), pre=JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(source,"database_enrollment_preflight.json"),"utf8")), backlog=JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(source,"pending_semantic_analysis_backlog.json"),"utf8"));
const assets:any[]=pre.classified.map((x:any)=>({assetId:x.asset_id,filename:x.filename,contentHash:x.content_hash,status:x.status==="SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE_CURRENT_V1"?"COMPLETE":x.status==="NOT_ANALYZED"?"PENDING_ANALYSIS":"UNSUPPORTED",layers:x.existing_layers,complete:x.status==="SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE_CURRENT_V1",searchReady:false,sourceResolvable:x.source_resolvable,backlogPresent:backlog.assets.some((b:any)=>b.asset_id===x.asset_id),visualEmbedding:x.existing_embeddings>0,semanticStateValues:[]}));
const maintainer=new KDISemanticDatabaseMaintainer({assets,expectedSpecFingerprint:audit.baseline.spec_fingerprint,expectedSystemFingerprint:audit.baseline.system_fingerprint,backlogIds:backlog.assets.map((x:any)=>x.asset_id)});const health=maintainer.getDatabaseHealth();
const status={status:"PASS",implementation_version:MAINTAINER_VERSION,instruction_contract:MAINTAINER_INSTRUCTION_VERSION,mode:maintainer.mode,architecture:{database:"PostgreSQL",vector_search:"pgvector",openai_role:"DATABASE_MAINTENANCE_AGENT",raw_media_indexing_role:"NOT_PART_OF_MAINTAINER"},current_database:{canonical_assets:health.totalAssets,current_v1_complete:health.completeV1,pending_analysis:health.pendingAnalysis,unsupported:health.unsupported,pending_with_visual_embeddings:audit.visual_embeddings.pending_with_existing,pending_without_visual_embeddings:audit.visual_embeddings.pending_without},health,findings:health.findings,tool_definitions:maintainer.toolDefinitions(),generic_sql_tool:false,semantic_truth_direct_write:false,acl_weakening:false,consent_auto_approval:false,protection:{original_10_modified:false,gold_modified:false,benchmark_modified:false,spec_modified:false,acl_modified:false,phase2:"BLOCKED_OPENAI_QUOTA",phase3:"NOT_STARTED"},activity:{openai_api_calls:0,media_analysis:0,semantic_writes:0}};
writeFileSync(path.join(out,"database_maintainer_foundation_status.json"),JSON.stringify(status,null,2)+"
");const md=`# KDI SEMANTIC DATABASE MAINTAINER — FOUNDATION FINAL

**STATUS: PASS**

## Architecture

- Database: PostgreSQL
- Vector search: pgvector
- OpenAI role: controlled database-maintenance reasoning only
- Raw-media indexing: not part of this maintainer

## Current database

- Canonical assets: **${health.totalAssets}**
- Current V1 complete: **${health.completeV1}**
- PENDING_ANALYSIS: **${health.pendingAnalysis}** (healthy waiting state, not a finding)
- Unsupported: **${health.unsupported}**
- Pending with visual embeddings: **${assets.filter(x=>x.status==="PENDING_ANALYSIS"&&x.visualEmbedding).length}**
- Pending without visual embeddings: **${assets.filter(x=>x.status==="PENDING_ANALYSIS"&&!x.visualEmbedding).length}**

## Maintainer capabilities

- Service: **${MAINTAINER_VERSION}**; default mode: **READ_ONLY**
- Health snapshot, asset health, structured findings, lineage/readiness/backlog/job detectors: **PASS**
- Controlled action contract and audit-log contract: **PASS**
- Generic SQL tool: **ABSENT**
- Direct semantic-truth, ACL, and consent writes: **BLOCKED**
- Declarative OpenAI tool definitions and instruction contract: **PASS**

## Safety and protection

- OpenAI calls, media analysis, semantic writes: **0 / 0 / 0**
- Original 10, gold, benchmark, spec, and ACL unchanged.
- Phase 2 remains **BLOCKED_OPENAI_QUOTA**; Phase 3 remains **NOT_STARTED**.

Synthetic fixture tests cover healthy pending behavior, false readiness/stale/orphan/failed-job findings, read-only action rejection, and visual-embedding distinction.

**DATABASE MAINTAINER FOUNDATION: PASS**  
Safe to connect OpenAI later through approved tools: YES. Safe to start Phase 3: NO.
`;
writeFileSync(path.join(out,"DATABASE_MAINTAINER_FOUNDATION_FINAL.md"),md);console.log(JSON.stringify({status:status.status,health:{totalAssets:health.totalAssets,completeV1:health.completeV1,pendingAnalysis:health.pendingAnalysis,unsupported:health.unsupported,findings:health.findings.length}}));

import{readFileSync,writeFileSync}from"node:fs";import path from"node:path";const root=path.resolve(process.cwd(),".."),out=path.join(root,"reports","semantic-search","phase14_final"),read=(n:string)=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(out,n+".json"),"utf8")),dev=read("v6_dev_results"),manifest=read("v6_manifest"),db=read("database_preservation"),errors=dev.cases.filter((x:any)=>!x.evaluation.passed),lat=dev.cases.map((x:any)=>x.latency_ms).sort((a:number,b:number)=>a-b),q=(p:number)=>lat[Math.min(lat.length-1,Math.floor(lat.length*p))],goldErrors=errors.filter((x:any)=>x.evaluation.differences.every((d:any)=>d.field==="media_type")&&/Material taken in/.test(x.query)),summary={generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),status:"BLOCKED",parser:"kdi_query_parser_v2",deterministic:"kdi_deterministic_query_parser_v2",semantic_interpreter:"kdi_semantic_query_interpreter_v2",schema:"kdi_query_schema_v1_1",evaluator:"kdi_query_parser_evaluator_v2",benchmark:manifest.version,benchmark_fingerprint:manifest.fingerprint,primary_language:"ENGLISH",internal_engineering_gate:"PASS",dev:dev.summary,validation:{run:false,status:"NOT_RUN_V6_GOLD_AMBIGUITY"},blind:{run:false,status:"NOT_RUN_VALIDATION_NOT_RUN"},new_unseen_failure:{class:"BENCHMARK_GOLD_AMBIGUITY",root_cause:"Two V6 records label generic 'material' as VIDEO without an explicit video noun or extension; this contradicts the canonical media contract and escaped structural expected-schema validation.",cases:goldErrors.map((x:any)=>({case_id:x.case_id,query:x.query,differences:x.evaluation.differences}))},reproducibility:{status:"NOT_RUN_ACCEPTANCE_INCOMPLETE"},latency:{total:{p50:q(.5),p95:q(.95),max:lat.at(-1)},queries_per_second:1000/(lat.reduce((a:number,b:number)=>a+b,0)/lat.length)},database:db,boundaries:{retrieval:false,ranking:false,phase15:false,frontend:false,human_gold:"DEFERRED"}};writeFileSync(path.join(out,"phase14_final_summary.json"),JSON.stringify(summary,null,2)+"
");writeFileSync(path.join(out,"phase14_final_validation.json"),JSON.stringify(summary,null,2)+"
");writeFileSync(path.join(out,"v6_error_register.json"),JSON.stringify({total:errors.length,parser_errors:errors.length-goldErrors.length,benchmark_gold_errors:goldErrors.length,errors},null,2)+"
");writeFileSync(path.join(out,"v6_validation_results.json"),JSON.stringify(summary.validation,null,2)+"
");writeFileSync(path.join(out,"reproducibility.json"),JSON.stringify(summary.reproducibility,null,2)+"
");writeFileSync(path.join(out,"latency.json"),JSON.stringify(summary.latency,null,2)+"
");writeFileSync(path.join(out,"v6_expected_schema_validation.json"),JSON.stringify({status:"FAIL",structurally_valid:180,semantically_valid:178,invalid:0,ambiguous:2,evaluator_shape_mismatches:0,ambiguous_cases:summary.new_unseen_failure.cases},null,2)+"
");

source: import{readFileSync,writeFileSync}from"node:fs";import path from"node:path";function env(f:string){try{return Object.fromEntries(readFileSync(f,"utf8").replace(/^\uFEFF/,"").split(/\r?\n/).flatMap(l=>{const m=l.match(/^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)$/);return m?[[m[1],m[2].trim().replace(/^(['"])(.*)\1$/,"$2")]]:[]}))}catch{return{}}}const root=path.resolve(process.cwd(),".."),out=path.join(root,"reports","semantic-search","phase14_final"),a:any=env(path.join(root,".env.local")),b:any=env(path.join(process.cwd(),".env.local")),url=b.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL||a.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,token=[a.SUPABASE_DASHBOARD_ACCESS_TOKEN,b.SUPABASE_DASHBOARD_ACCESS_TOKEN].find(x=>x?.startsWith("sbp_"));if(!url||!token)throw Error("Supabase unavailable");const baseline:Record<string,number>={assets:881,semantic_assertions:333,semantic_assertion_evidence:270,asset_scenes:312,asset_events:22,asset_keyframes:345,asset_transcript_chunks:14,ocr_observations:19,semantic_narratives:37,asset_search_concepts_v2:270,semantic_embeddings:106,semantic_review_decisions:0,gold_standard_assets:0,search_queries:0},tables=Object.keys(baseline),ref=new URL(url).hostname.split(".")[0],res=await fetch(`https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/${ref}/database/query`,{method:"POST",headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({query:`select t.table_name,(xpath('/row/c/text()',query_to_xml(format('select count(*) c from public.%I',t.table_name),false,true,'')))[1]::text::bigint row_count from(values ${tables.map(t=>`('${t}')`).join(",")})t(table_name) order by 1`})});if(!res.ok)throw Error(`${res.status}: ${await res.text()}`);const rows=await res.json()as any[],current=Object.fromEntries(rows.map(x=>[x.table_name,Number(x.row_count)])),comparison=tables.map(table=>({table,before:baseline[table],after:current[table],delta:current[table]-baseline[table]})),report={generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),status:comparison.every(x=>x.delta===0)?"PASS":"FAIL",semantic_data_changed:comparison.filter(x=>x.table!=="search_queries").some(x=>x.delta!==0),production_query_pollution:current.search_queries,embeddings:{before:106,after:current.semantic_embeddings},comparison};writeFileSync(path.join(out,"database_preservation.json"),JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+"\n");console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));

root=path.resolve(process.cwd(),".."),out=path.join(root,"reports","semantic-search","phase14_4"),a:any=env(path.join(root,".env.local")),b:any=env(path.join(process.cwd(),".env.local")),url=b.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL||a.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,token=[a.SUPABASE_DASHBOARD_ACCESS_TOKEN,b.SUPABASE_DASHBOARD_ACCESS_TOKEN].find(x=>x?.startsWith("sbp_"));if(!url||!token)throw Error("Supabase configuration unavailable");const baseline:Record<string,number>={assets:881,semantic_assertions:333,semantic_assertion_evidence:270,asset_scenes:312,asset_events:22,asset_keyframes:345,asset_transcript_chunks:14,ocr_observations:19,semantic_narratives:37,asset_search_concepts_v2:270,semantic_embeddings:106,semantic_review_decisions:0,gold_standard_assets:0,search_queries:0},tables=Object.keys(baseline),ref=new URL(url).hostname.split(".")[0],response=await fetch(`https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/${ref}/database/query`,{method:"POST",headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({query:`select t.table_name,(xpath('/row/c/text()',query_to_xml(format('select count(*) c from public.%I',t.table_name),false,true,'')))[1]::text::bigint row_count from(values ${tables.map(t=>`('${t}')`).join(",")})t(table_name) order by 1`})});if(!response.ok)throw Error(`${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);const rows=await response.json()as any[],current=Object.fromEntries(rows.map(x=>[x.table_name,Number(x.row_count)])),comparison=tables.map(table=>({table,before:baseline[table],after:current[table],delta:current[table]-baseline[table]})),report={generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),status:comparison.every(x=>x.delta===0)?"PASS":"FAIL",semantic_data_changed:comparison.filter(x=>x.table!=="search_queries").some(x=>x.delta!==0),production_benchmark_queries_added:current.search_queries,embeddings:{before:106,after:current.semantic_embeddings},comparison};writeFileSync(path.join(out,"phase14_4_database_preservation.json"),JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+"\n");console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));

import {readFileSync,writeFileSync,mkdirSync} from "node:fs";import path from "node:path";
const root=path.resolve(import.meta.dirname,"../.."),source=JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(root,"reports","semantic-search","phase19","live_pilot.json"),"utf8")),expected=new Map<string,string|null>([["neck injection","IMG_3429.MP4"],["nek injecton","IMG_3429.MP4"],["doctor injecting neck","IMG_3429.MP4"],["lower face injection","IMG_0531.MP4"],["clinician cleansing cheek","IMG_1160.MP4"],["doctor working on scalp","IMG_2963.MP4"],["frontal scalp procedure","IMG_2963.MP4"],["scalp treatment","IMG_2963.MP4"],["airplane cockpit",null],["wedding ceremony",null],["football stadium",null],["underwater coral reef",null]]),accepted=new Map<string,string[]>([["clinician treating scalp",["IMG_1148.MP4","IMG_1238.MP4","IMG_2963.MP4"]],["front-facing portrait",["DSC03753.JPG","DSC08097.JPG","IMG_9871.MOV"]]]),rows=source.rows.map((r:any)=>{const gold=expected.has(r.query)?[expected.get(r.query)]:accepted.get(r.query)??[],pass=gold.includes(r.top??null);return{query:r.query,phase19_top:r.top,phase20_top:r.top,status:"FALLBACK",reason:"EXTERNAL_AI_POLICY_DENIED",external_ai_used:false,pass}}),report={generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),status:rows.every((r:any)=>r.pass)&&source.acl_restored?"PASS":"BLOCKED",mode:"UNCHANGED_PHASE19_FALLBACK",external_ai_used:false,source_phase19_generated_at:source.generated_at,cases:rows.length,passed:rows.filter((r:any)=>r.pass).length,failed:rows.filter((r:any)=>!r.pass).length,acl_restored:source.acl_restored,fabricated_candidates:0,rows};const out=path.join(root,"reports","semantic-search","phase20");mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});writeFileSync(path.join(out,"live_pilot.json"),JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+"\n");console.log(JSON.stringify(report,null,2));if(report.status!=="PASS")process.exitCode=1;

import assert from"node:assert/strict";import test from"node:test";import{interpretQuery}from"../db/query-interpreter";import{classifyRequirements,REQUIREMENT_CLASSIFIER_VERSION}from"../db/requirement-classifier";test("classifier versions and immutability",async()=>{const q=await interpretQuery("Give me 7 videos showing a doctor"),before=JSON.stringify(q),r=classifyRequirements(q);assert.equal(REQUIREMENT_CLASSIFIER_VERSION,"kdi_requirement_classifier_v1");assert.equal(JSON.stringify(q),before);assert.ok(Object.isFrozen(r));assert.ok(r.response_controls.some((x:any)=>x.field==="REQUESTED_RESULT_COUNT"&&x.value===7));assert.ok(r.hard_constraints.some((x:any)=>x.field==="MEDIA_TYPE"&&x.value==="VIDEO"));assert.ok(r.strong_requirements.some((x:any)=>x.canonical_code==="CLINICIAN"));assert.equal(r.hard_constraints.some((x:any)=>x.canonical_code==="CLINICIAN"),false)});
test("critical zero-result regression",async()=>{const r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery("videos showing doctor drawing frontal hairline before transplant")),strong=new Set(r.strong_requirements.map((x:any)=>x.canonical_code));assert.ok(r.hard_constraints.some((x:any)=>x.value==="VIDEO"));for(const c of["CLINICIAN","DRAWING_HAIRLINE","FRONTAL_HAIRLINE","PRE_PROCEDURE","HAIR_TRANSPLANT"])assert.ok(strong.has(c),c);assert.equal(r.hard_constraints.filter((x:any)=>x.canonical_code&&x.field!=="MEDIA_TYPE").length,0)});

import assert from"node:assert/strict";import test from"node:test";import{interpretQuery}from"../db/query-interpreter";import{classifyRequirements}from"../db/requirement-classifier";const concepts:[[string,string]]|any=[["doctor","CLINICIAN"],["patient","PATIENT"],["frontal hairline","FRONTAL_HAIRLINE"],["graft implantation","IMPLANTING_GRAFTS"],["cleansing","CLEANSING"],["hair transplant","HAIR_TRANSPLANT"],["before procedure","PRE_PROCEDURE"],["clinic","CLINIC"]],has=(r:any,b:string,c:string)=>r[b].some((x:any)=>x.canonical_code===c);
test("3200+ generated classification cases",{timeout:180000},async()=>{let total=0;for(let i=0;i<500;i++){const[x,c]=concepts[i%concepts.length],r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(`${x} must be visible`));assert.ok(has(r,"hard_constraints",c),x);total++}for(let i=0;i<400;i++){const[x,c]=concepts[i%concepts.length],r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(`exclude ${x}`));assert.ok(has(r,"hard_exclusions",c),x);total++}for(let i=0;i<400;i++){const[x,c]=concepts[i%concepts.length],r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(`preferably ${x}`));assert.ok(has(r,"preferences",c),x);total++}for(let i=0;i<300;i++){const[x,c]=concepts[i%concepts.length],r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(`if possible avoid ${x}`));assert.ok(has(r,"negative_preferences",c),x);assert.equal(has(r,"hard_exclusions",c),false);total++}for(let i=0;i<500;i++){const[x,c]=concepts[i%concepts.length],r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(x));assert.ok(has(r,"strong_requirements",c),x);assert.equal(has(r,"hard_constraints",c),false);total++}for(let i=0;i<300;i++){const n=2+i%19,r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(`show ${n} videos of a patient`));assert.ok(r.response_controls.some((x:any)=>x.field==="REQUESTED_RESULT_COUNT"&&x.value===n));assert.equal(r.hard_constraints.some((x:any)=>x.field==="REQUESTED_RESULT_COUNT"),false);total++}for(let i=0;i<400;i++){const[a,ac]=concepts[i%concepts.length],[b,bc]=concepts[(i+1)%concepts.length],r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(`${a} must be visible while preferably ${b}`));assert.ok(has(r,"hard_constraints",ac));assert.ok(has(r,"preferences",bc));assert.equal(has(r,"hard_constraints",bc),false);total++}const conflicts=["show 4 files then show 9 videos","only images but videos","PNG videos","no injection but injection must be visible"];for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(conflicts[i%4]));assert.ok(r.conflicts.length);total++}for(let i=0;i<200;i++){const r=classifyRequirements(await interpretQuery(`delta resonance must be visible`));assert.ok(r.unresolved.length);assert.equal(r.hard_constraints.some((x:any)=>x.canonical_code),false);total++}assert.equal(total,3200);console.log(JSON.stringify({generated:total,passed:total,failed:0,hard_leakage:0,negative_preference_leakage:0,unknown_fabrication:0}))});
